text_block_list.text: Oh... Trainer... It's you. Perfect timing...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
How about some hot-off-the-press
divination,
ready to go? I spent my
whole day off thinking it
up. I didn't get
a wink of sleep!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
First, you make a peace sign like this,
okay? And
then you...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
It looks like Матиканэфукукитару hasn't
rested at
all...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
